tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind the shell (Tailwind gray-100 / gray-900 today).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the sidebar, cards, dialogs, menus (white / gray-800).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header rows, hover, code blocks (gray-50 / gray-700).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers only (gray-200 / gray-700). Never a control border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and pills (gray-500). At least 3:1 on canvas and panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons: headings, values, data (gray-800 / gray-100).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, descriptions, metadata, dates (gray-600 / gray-300). The project sets this at about 7:1 (webapp/docs/architecture.md, Typography & Contrast).

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Form errors, always with an icon and words (red-800 / red-400).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a solid 2px outline at a 2px offset (violet-600 / violet-400).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand violet inherited from the Mosaic shell (violet-600 / violet-500): primary buttons, active nav, unread badges. Not for body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page foot.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the sidebar's rounded edge (rounded-2xl).
